pages.text: $(#8B4513)🌳 Rootbound Symphony · Earth’s Blessing 🥣$()$(br2)$(l)$(#D2691E)「Sacrificing speed to obtain the endurance of an ancient tree」$()$(br)The robustness of $(#8B4513)Forest Anaconda Mushrooms$(), the nourishment of $(#FF8C00)Sunlight Carrots$(), the vitality of $(#8B0000)Beet Essence$(), and the richness of $(#EEE8AA)Moonlight Cream$() simmer together in the $(#556B2F)Oakwood Cauldron$()—a druidic elixir that allows $(l)the body to resonate with the earth$().

$(#8B4513)▌ Nature’s Balance $()$(br2)$(l)$(#FF69B4)🌱 Life Stream$()$(br)Veins glow with $(#FF6B6B)sakura-colored waves$(), continuously healing wounds.$(br2)$(l)$(#006400)🌳 Ancient Root Vessels$()$(br)Maximum health increases by $(#32CD32)❤×4$().$(br2)$(#696969)⚠ Earthbound Shackles $()$(br)$(l)$(#808080)⛓ Root Bind$()$(br)Walking causes $(#8B4513)wood-like textures$() to grow on the feet, reducing movement speed.

$(br2)$(#556B2F)▌ Forest Ritual $()$(br)- Sun-dry $(#8B4513)mushroom caps$() under $(#FF8C00)noon sunlight$() until they become $(#D2691E)amber-hued$().$(br)- Soak $(#FF8C00)carrots$() in $(#8B0000)beet juice$() to form $(#CD5C5C)blood-red crystal clusters$().$(br)- When mixing in $(#EEE8AA)cream$(), perform the $(#006400)three-forward, three-reverse$() stirring ritual.$(br2)$(#DAA520)※$() A successful brew will display $(#8B4513)tree-ring patterns$() and emit $(#32CD32)fresh grassy aroma$().

$(br2)$(#8B4513)『 Ancient Tree Codex 』$()$(br)Druidic inscriptions carved into bark:$(br)'Those who drink this shall gain:$(br)- $(#FF69B4)The regenerative force of forest spirits$().$(br)- $(#006400)The endurance of ancient war trees$().$(br)However, they must bear the $(#696969)Earth Mother’s$() $(#8B4513)root-binding restraint$()—$(br)as if $(#556B2F)trudging through a swamp$(),$(br)a gentle punishment for $(#FF8C00)those who greedily take from nature$().'
